name: classify
description: Classifies every prompt/tool interaction (human and agent) into configurable categories via TypeSafe AI Jev; stores results in SQLite and renders 1/7/30/90-day statistics.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which System One API to route Jev classification calls through

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Key for the selected provider (typesafe/openrouter/vercel AI gateway). Stored securely in the Keychain — alternatively export TYPESAFE_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY yourself.

model.title: Model
model.description: System One model id (e.g. jev-latest, or typesafe-ai/jev for the Vercel gateway)

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: One entry per category, format 'name|short description'. Leave empty to use the built-in defaults.

confidence_threshold.title: Confidence threshold
confidence_threshold.description: Below this confidence the row is recorded as 'uncertain'

top2_gap.title: Top-2 gap
top2_gap.description: If the top two category probabilities are closer than this, record as 'uncertain'

laya_port.title: Laya server port
laya_port.description: Port of a local laya.serve instance (provider 'laya'); auto-started if not running

laya_python.title: Laya Python interpreter
laya_python.description: Interpreter used to auto-start laya.serve (must have laya/laya-mlx/laya-coreml installed)

adaptive_threshold.title: Adaptive chunk threshold
adaptive_threshold.description: Stop extending the incremental chunk window once the winning category's mean probability reaches this

adaptive_max_chunks.title: Adaptive max chunks
adaptive_max_chunks.description: Upper bound on chunks classified per long text

chunk_tokens.title: Chunk size (tokens)
chunk_tokens.description: Approximate tokens per chunk in adaptive mode (~4 chars per token)
